content: Muneeŋ ugamali metam fiyewakahi yehiulihidok
Bepaŋ’walaŋ metam yehiulihidok muneeŋ boine kaŋ Galesiyahi kayoŋbop yenindakalegut unduŋ taneeŋ.
U indiŋ taneeŋdok hanilat. Hidi muneeŋ kwanai tubune muneeŋ mintahamuluwaak uŋaniŋ Sonda indigoŋ tuwot molomolom ugamali bopneyaneeŋ. Ala uŋoŋ busuwawene muneeŋ kotigoŋ mu hati-ugamatneeŋ.
Nu busuwawaatneŋ adi yodakale mede pepa foloŋ youla me nedigoŋ nadiyembune utumbaune muneeŋ beŋa uuŋdok yenindapmagiŋ adi yemiŋa yeniŋkutne hidi siloŋdok muneeŋ boigiŋ u beŋa Jelusalemde uneeŋ.
Be hidi nadiune tuwot tubune kaŋ nakat noŋgoŋ uneem.
Poldi kwet deŋandiŋ kwanai ti-yawaakdok yeniŋguk
Nai indidegoŋ adi Masedoniya kwetneŋ uyeŋ dapmaŋ hidi’walaŋkade waat. Tiŋa Masedoniya kwetneŋ uŋoŋ yagigi mu hatibaat. Hogok dapmatau tibaat.
Eŋ hidut adigili yagigigoŋ binek hatiyane gwi mulum nai tibaak. Ala mindaŋkade hidi kedem talikdok nehiulihiune talikne uŋoŋ be uŋoŋ yawaat.
Kamiŋ yoŋ adi me nalum wele hogok dapmatau mu titiŋdok nadilat. Bepaŋdi nadinambune tuwot tubune hidut nai muniniŋ hatiŋa hapmeŋ baat.

Iŋoŋ adi Wapumdi kwanai titiŋdok talik momooŋ tubutomnamulak, iŋgoŋ oŋ, baŋamneŋ uŋgoŋ memikneye fee hatiiŋ doktiŋa Efeso iŋgoŋ kabe-muniniŋ hatiluwene Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli foguk diniŋ nai (Pentikos) tibaak.

Niŋ indiŋ hanindidimewene nadineŋ. Timoti adi Wapum’walaŋ kwanai na tilat wendok tuwolit hinek tilak. Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi’walaŋkade busuwaaŋ hatibune menot momooŋ timineeŋ. Unduŋ timimbune adi muntamuntayeŋgoŋ mu hatibaak.
Eŋ nebek niŋdi sigilulum mu timimbaak. Kulemaŋgoŋ hinek kameune udaneeŋ nu’walaŋkade baak. Adi notniye nadisukilitihinit noli dut wanaŋ buneeŋ. Nu adi aditegoŋ woomilat.
Kaŋ notnik Apolo adi metam kayoŋbop noli dut wanakaŋ wooŋ habudok niŋkulene mu lodaaŋ ulak. Ale kougoŋ nai niŋ mintaune waak.
Nadisukiliti gineŋ fafaŋeŋ kikadoko taneeŋ
Niŋ indiŋ hanilat. Hidi kikadoko tiŋa kiulihi tiŋila nadisukiliti gineŋ fafaŋeneeŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa gweheye mu tiŋa fafaŋe tiŋa yatneeŋ.
Eŋ nemenemek hogohogok u welehik siloniŋgoŋ taneeŋ.

Tiŋa notneye, niŋ indiŋ hanimbene nadineŋ. Akaia kwetneŋ Stefana bopŋiye adi timeŋ tububihila wele tubutakale tiŋa kayoŋbop gineŋ tomboyoukiŋ, tiŋa nai indidegoŋ Mede Momooŋ ulihiŋa kwanaineiŋ. U hidi agaŋ nadiiŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi Stefana meŋiye be metam noli yehitomboyoula Mede Momooŋ kwanai noŋgoŋ tiiŋ, me undihi’walaŋ mede nadiŋa takaliyaneeŋ.
Nu mewoi, Stefana eŋ Fotunata tiŋa Akaikus hekidi buŋa hidi wanaŋ hehikiulaŋa hiditok kayoŋkoŋ mede kahat tinambune welemomooŋ nadihamulat.
Adi unduŋ tubune hidi be indi welenik kulemaguk. Ale hidi me undihidok welemomooŋ nadiyemiŋa medehik nadiyaneeŋ.
Yodapmaŋ mede
Wapum diniŋ kayoŋbop Esiya kwet dikidikineŋ hatiiŋdi hiditok welemomooŋ nadihamiiŋ. Akwila eŋ Piliska tiŋa metam adi’walaŋ yohineŋ bopneŋ Bepaŋ niutumbaiŋ, adi maaŋ hiditok welemomooŋ nadihamiiŋ.
Iŋahi metam kayoŋbop hogohogok hiditok welemomooŋ nadihamiiŋ. Ale kayoŋbop hidi hidebo kohokukut tineeŋ.
Nu Pol, nagoŋ welemomooŋ hinek nadihamuŋa haniutumbaaŋ na kohonedi youhamulat.
Nediyendi Wapum welesiloŋ mu timimbaak adi yadi hamdok gigit tibaak. O Wapumnik, du beŋ.
Wapumnik Jesu Kilisto’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ u hidut hatuwaak.
Kilisto Jesu wou foloŋ na welenedi hidi wanakaŋ habukahile hinek tilat. Unduŋ hogok.
